screensaver.name: screensaver-mesh
screensaver._description:
Your Meshtastic mesh, live from MeshMonitor. Nodes drift across the screen, links join the ones in reach, and every message sent on the mesh travels across it as a packet.
Put the API token in ~/.config/screensaver-mesh/config (token=mm_v1_...), not here: options on this page end up on the command line, where other users of this computer can see them. Custom colors go in the same file.
Without a server it shows a simulated mesh.
https://github.com/maxhayim/screensaver-mesh
